summary: Frontend e2e UI tests for (A) Driver Earnings 'today-takings-card' and (B) Client Loyalty Rewards catalog with redemption flows. All requested testids and flows are working correctly.

minor.issue: Returned 404 for client test2@example.com during this run — could not verify SB Pay balance increment directly via /api/wallet/me. Toast confirmed '2.00 € crédités sur votre SB Pay' so loyalty->wallet path appears to work, but the wallet endpoint path used in this test may be wrong (could be /api/payments/wallet or /api/sbpay/me). Main agent to confirm correct wallet endpoint and ensure /wallet UI displays the new balance.

loyalty_rewards_catalog.reward_cards: all 4 cards rendered (credit_2, credit_5, ride_10pct, free_delivery); each with active 'Échanger' button at Gold tier with 600 pts

action_items: Optional: verify /wallet page actually shows the updated SB Pay balance after credit_2 redemption. The /api/wallet/me endpoint returned 404 in our probe; main agent should confirm the canonical wallet endpoint and that the UI reflects the +2€ credit.
critical_code_review_comments: DriverEarningsPage.js uses a raw fetch in useEffect without auth credentials handling beyond credentials:'include'; if cookie auth ever drifts to Bearer-only this card would silently show 0. Consider routing through the shared driverAPI client.

LoyaltyPage.jsx redeem() uses an optimistic toast based on d.granted shape — if backend ever returns a different granted.type the toast falls into 'Code obtenu : undefined'. Adding a default branch (e.g., 'Récompense échangée') would be safer.
Both new screens lack a visible loading state for their secondary fetches (rewards / takings). On slow networks the card briefly displays 0.00 € / no rewards before populating. Minor UX nit.
test_credentials: jean.dupont@demo.sb / Driver123! (driver) ; test2@example.com / TestPass123! (client, Gold 600 pts) — both worked
seed_data_creation: Consumed seeded loyalty points (600 -> 100). If retesting, main agent should reset test2's loyalty points to 600 (and revert spent_points) so the catalog state matches the original spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is phone-by-default on /login; use API login via POST /api/auth/login (HttpOnly cookie) when running E2E with email credentials — avoids needing to find the email-login toggle. Driver earnings page is at /chauffeur/earnings; QR receive page at /encaisser. After this run, test2@example.com loyalty available_points are ~100 (was 600). credit_2 (200 pts) was redeemed -> wallet credit; ride_10pct (300 pts) was redeemed -> coupon code SBREWARD-2D5C7A.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional issues observed. Only an observation that GET /api/wallet/me returned 404; likely the SB Pay wallet route is on a different path. The redeem path itself succeeded (toast + points decremented).
